def format_bytes(n):
    """Return a human-readable size string for a byte count n."""
    units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB']
    size = float(n)
    unit = units[0]
    while size >= 1024 and unit != units[-1]:
        size /= 1024
        unit = units[units.index(unit) + 1]
    if unit == 'B':
        return f'{int(size)} {unit}'
    return f'{size:.1f} {unit}'
